QUOTE: "`scope` (`file_count`, `extensions`, `not_indexed`) | Exactly which files were read. Here: 426 files, with `.rs`, `.toml`, `.sql`, `.lock`, `.csv`, `.jsonl`, `.motor` and extensionless files left out." and "Term lives in an extension listed under `not_indexed`: no confidence. The reply names those files, so use Grep on them."

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer names file types that were NOT indexed (`not_indexed`), not file types that were in scope and produced no rows. It gives the distinction between "not in repo" and "not indexed", but the item asks for the reply to list in-scope extensions that returned zero rows. The answer mentions `extensions` in scope but never says the reply lists in-scope types with zero rows.
